procedural_matters: No party came to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: The protest/redress form does not identify the initiator, respondents or any incident.
conclusions: The protest did not identify the protestor and protestee nor the incident as required by RRS 60.3(a).
The request for redress did not identify the reasons for making it, as required by RRS 61.2.
decision: The protest and request for redress is invalid - the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
